name: external_extremeinjector_threadhijack_ac
description: ExtremeInjector Thread Hijacking delivery of the controlled TestDll payload. Verify delivery independently; record execution primitives separately from mapping mode.

extra.attacker_bitness: managed injector with architecture-matched target support; record observed processes
extra.provenance: docs/external-cheats/README.md; fill actual tool/game hashes and runtime version before collection.
extra.operator_commands: Launch Extreme Injector v3.exe and select the exact printed target PID (x86). Add only ProcessToolkit\Win32\Release\TestDll.dll. Choose Thread Hijacking in Settings. Leave export/init function empty. Scrambling None; Secure Mode, Stealth Inject, Auto-Inject, Erase PE, Hide Module and automatic closing OFF. Record settings, inject ONCE and record status plus the target's TestDll attach marker (recorded by runner v2). Observe 30 seconds from injection, close the injector, then press Enter here. Keep the game alive for cooldown.
extra.success_criterion: Runner v2 observes the target-specific TestDll attach event. Record injector outcome and confirm target remains usable. Leave export/init function empty.
extra.notes: Fresh target, one injection, same architecture-matched TestDll as Standard/Manual Map. All scrambling and post-injection options off. Distinguish configured mapping mode from observed primitives.
extra.delivery_lineage: darthton-manual-mapper (shared ancestry; group conservatively for family holdout)
extra.payload_protocol: DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH only. Leave export/init function empty; do not call RunTest.
extra.binary_source_status: Official prebuilt release; source unavailable. Actual running tool hash and PID are recorded by runner v2.
